overview: Review and download public HTTPS media through Misty’s restricted native service.
capabilities: Convert downloads into MP3, M4A, MP4, or WEBM
Save media into sensible local destinations
permissions: Connect to public media sites through Misty’s filtered network service
Write completed media into a folder chosen explicitly
Use Misty’s Host-owned restricted media service
getting_started: Install the yt-dlp app from the Store.
Open it from Apps in a workspace tab.
Paste a supported media URL and review the download.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Replaced shell access with explicit destination grants and a Host-owned restricted downloader and filtered public-network service on macOS.
v0.3.0 - Moved yt-dlp into the workspace app tab with resumable job status.
v0.2.0 - Added media inspection, playlist safeguards, cancellable download jobs, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Added the initial yt-dlp panel.
